meaning:
1) to dim, darken, grow dark
1a) (Qal) to dim, eclipse, be held dark
1b) (Hophal) to be dimmed, grow dark

elsewhere.note: How the gold has become dim! The most pure gold has changed! The stones of the sanctuary are poured out at the head of every street.
behold, you are wiser than Daniel; there is no secret that is hidden from you;
